## 6. Runtime view

### Fixed routes

The routes the server answers beside its operations, GET and HEAD alone (ADR-216): the application's document, served at its path and at every page route under it with its content security policy and a nonce made for each response; the files of a folder, never a listing; the health of the service, 200 while healthy and 503 with the reason. Each is closed unless its permission is held, and Caching is its Cache-Control header: a stored response is public when the route is public and private otherwise.

| Route | Path | Serves | Permission | Caching |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| app | / | application | public | no-store |
| reports | /reports/ | files | notices.read | private, max-age=600 |
| health | /health | health | public | no-store |

Route app answers with Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' nonce; nonce stands for the value made for each response.

## 8. Cross-cutting concepts

### Permissions

Access is fail-closed: every operation, command, page and route names the one permission it needs, and only the roles below grant one.

| Permission | reader | public |
|---|---|---|
| public | | everyone |
| notices.read | yes | |

## 10. Quality requirements

The design tests: what must hold on every implementation. Golden scenarios succeed; red scenarios are refused.

| Test | Subject | Level | Scenario | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| app-succeeds | route app | system | golden | any caller | GET / is requested | it answers 200 with the document and a nonce in its policy |
| app-method-not-allowed | route app | system | red | any caller | / is requested with POST | it answers 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD |
| reports-succeeds | route reports | system | golden | a caller with notices.read | a file under /reports/ is requested | it answers 200 with the file |
| reports-denied-without-notices-read | route reports | system | red | a caller without notices.read | a file under /reports/ is requested | it is refused as not allowed |
| reports-not-found-file | route reports | system | red | no file of that name is under the folder | a file that is not there is requested under /reports/ | it answers 404 |
| reports-path-outside-the-folder | route reports | system | red | a request whose path climbs out of the folder with .. | it is requested under /reports/ | it is refused and no file outside the folder is read |
| health-succeeds | route health | system | golden | any caller | GET /health is requested | it answers 200: the service is healthy |
| health-unhealthy | route health | system | red | what the service needs is not reachable | GET /health is requested | it answers 503 naming what is not healthy |
